    @allure.title("Verify that blocking a comment's content via 'Report this Comment' removes only that comment")
    @allure.description("Blocks a specific comment as spam and confirms only that comment disappears, while the post and other comments remain intact.")
    @pytest.mark.priority(63)
    def test_block_content_on_comment_removes_only_that_comment(self):
    	unique_subject = f"{TEST_SUBJECT} CommentBlockRemoval"
    	self.team.post_subject_and_description(unique_subject, TEST_DESCRIPTION)
    	first_post = self.page.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.POST_CARD).first
    	survivor_comment = "[Automation Test] survivor comment removal check"
    	first_post.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.COMMENT_INPUT).click()
    	first_post.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.COMMENT_INPUT).fill(survivor_comment)
    	first_post.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.COMMENT_BUTTON).click()
    	first_post.locator(f"text={survivor_comment}").first.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
    
    	self.login.logoutBy_skippingUI(self.user_webUrl)
    	self.page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    	self.login.userPortal_login(self.login_credentials["webUsername"], self.login_credentials["webUserPassword"])
    	self.page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    	self.team.open_talk_to_my_team_panel()
    	target_comment = "[Automation Test] target comment for removal"
    	first_post_ou = self.page.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.POST_CARD).first
    	first_post_ou.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.COMMENT_INPUT).click()
    	first_post_ou.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.COMMENT_INPUT).fill(target_comment)
    	first_post_ou.locator(TalkToMyTeamPage.COMMENT_BUTTON).click()
    	self.page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    	self.login.logoutBy_skippingUI(self.user_webUrl)
    	self.page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    	self.login.userPortal_login(self.login_credentials["webUsernamebacklogs"], self.login_credentials["webUserPasswordbacklogs"])
    	self.page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    	self.team.open_talk_to_my_team_panel()
    	self.team.block_comment_as_spam(target_comment)
